# Karolis Tamosiunas

> Founder and full-stack engineer in Phoenix, Arizona. Builds custom software, AI agents, and automation for businesses that run on manual work, including his own storage business. Works with clients remotely.

## What he builds

- Business management software: dashboards, customer management, leases, inventory, reporting
- Customer-facing systems: online booking, self-service portals, payments, automated agreements
- Financial automation: QuickBooks sync, automated invoicing, payment tracking, custom reports
- AI agents and workflows: document parsing, data extraction, automated follow-ups

## How to start

- The Automation Blueprint: $999, fixed scope, delivered in one week. A map of how work flows through the business, automation opportunities ranked with ROI math, a build-or-buy recommendation for each, and a fixed quote for anything worth building. The $999 is credited toward the build.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.karolis.ai/): overview and a live intake agent
- [Yards](https://www.karolis.ai/yards): one system for truck parking, storage and RV yards (booking, e-sign leases, payments, QuickBooks sync, collections, gate codes), built by a software engineer who also runs his own yards in Phoenix; remote across the US
- [Truck parking software](https://www.karolis.ai/yards/truck-parking): booking, leases, fleet accounts, billing, insurance and gate codes for truck and trailer parking yards
- [RV and boat storage software](https://www.karolis.ai/yards/rv-boat-storage): spaces by length and cover, waitlists, leases, billing and gate codes for RV and boat storage
- [Outdoor storage software](https://www.karolis.ai/yards/outdoor-storage): lots by size, leases, insurance on file, billing and gate access for contractor and equipment yards
- [Late payments](https://www.karolis.ai/yards/late-payments): collections for yards, with reminders, late fees, promises to pay, and notices and lockouts that wait for the owner's OK
- [Gate codes](https://www.karolis.ai/yards/gate-codes): one code per tenant, sent on signup and turned off at move-out, built around the yard's existing gate
- [Online booking](https://www.karolis.ai/yards/online-booking): customers pick a spot, sign and pay online on the yard's own website, with no marketplace fee
- [Work](https://www.karolis.ai/work): shipped projects, including Flux Sync (SaaS for storage-yard operators) and the software that runs Paddock Parking
- [Services](https://www.karolis.ai/services): what he builds, the Blueprint offer, and common questions
- [About](https://www.karolis.ai/about): background
- [Contact](https://www.karolis.ai/contact): intake form, email, and phone
